body.purpose: Retrieve one exact book's identity and lifetime fixture totals.
when_to_use: Retrieve one exact book's identity and lifetime fixture totals.
when_not_to_use: Do not guess an ID from a title. Resolve via get_books first; use receipt tool for a ledger.

rules: Use an existing local ID such as B001; unknown IDs fail.

preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
